correctness.rationale: Route is TARGET (research_report.claim_route='TARGET'); audited normally against admitted target 'No binary doubly-even self-dual [48,24,12] admits order-15 type 15-(3;3) automorphism'. The delivered proof in fact proves the stronger statement for every binary self-dual [48,24] (singly or doubly even, any distance) — a valid proof strengthening within the target, not a substitution. Every essential inference verified independently: (Lemma 1) tau=sigma^5 descent 15-(3;3)->3-(15;3): recomputed on representative sigma (three 15-cycles + 3 fixed points) giving cycle type [1,1,1]+[3]*15, order exactly 3, fixed set exactly the 3 sigma-fixed points; extension to all sigma by S48 conjugacy invariance is correct. (Lemma 2) odd-order fixed-subcode self-duality: proof checked line by line — orthogonality of permutation action, projector pi(v)=sum tau^i v with m odd so m=1 in F2, adjoint identity <pi(v),w>=<v,w> for fixed w, nondegeneracy on V^tau because all orbit lengths (3 and 1) are odd so <e_O,e_O>=1, self-orthogonality bound dim<=9, and double-containment C(tau)^perp=C(tau) via pi(x) in C(tau). Hypotheses satisfied: tau has order 3 (odd) and all 18 orbit lengths odd. Corollary dim C(tau)=18/2=9 correct. (Lemma 3) idempotent e=1+t+t^2: e^2=e verified by 9-pair residue count (3 per residue, 3=1 mod 2) and mask algebra; te=e, e(1+e)=0, direct-sum split of tau-stable C with dim eC=9, dim W=15 correct. (Kill) tau acts fixed-point-freely on W (tw=w implies ew=3w=w, but eW=0 so w=0); hence nonzero vectors partitioned into 3-orbits, so 3|(2^15-1). Direct computation 2^15-1=32767=3*10922+1=1 mod 3 contradicts. Equivalent GF(4)-module parity gloss correct (1+t+t^2 root-free over F2). Independent second kill via rho=sigma^3 type 5-(9;3), fixed dim 12/2=6, remainder 18, 2^18-1=262143=3 mod 5 so 5 does not divide, also recomputed VERIFY_OK; irreducibility check of x^4+x^3+x^2+x+1 over F2 correct. All three replay scripts re-executed by auditor with VERIFY_OK. Apparent enumeration discrepancy resolved: verify_lemma2.py counts 420 ordered generating triples spanning distinct [6,3] codes (not 15 distinct codes — auditor recomputed 15 distinct codes, 3 tau-stable), and asserts fixed-dim 1 for all 84 tau-stable triples; this still stress-tests Lemma 2 correctly and the analytic proof does not depend on the count. Boundary conditions (odd order, odd orbit lengths, permutation action, binary self-dual) all stated and met. No computation mistaken for proof: the obstruction is a complete proof, scripts are replays of finite checks.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively, not by timestamp: (1) Bouyuklieva-Willems-Yankov arXiv:1403.4735 proves general pq fixed-subcode structure and applies it to exclude order-15 automorphisms of extremal [96,48,20] — different length, different cycle types, no length-48 15-(3;3) statement; live arXiv search 'self-dual length 48 automorphism order 15' returns only this paper, confirming no length-48 analogue at title/abstract level. (2) Guenther-Nebe arXiv:0810.3787 (Alt-group + module criterion) permits 15-(3;3) (each 15-cycle is 14 transpositions, three give even permutation) but implies no enumerator/dimension exclusion for [48,24,12]. (3) Betsumiya-Harada-Munemasa arXiv:1104.3727 classifies doubly-even self-dual codes only to length 40; length-48 window lies strictly beyond. (4) Freibert-Kim, Cao dihedral D48 (arXiv:1902.07533), Dougherty et al group rings (arXiv:1604.07863), involution study (arXiv:2208.00299), ternary length-48 and Nebe ternary results are different families/windows and do not state or mechanically imply this exclusion. Live searches 'doubly even self dual length 48 automorphism' (0 hits), 'extremal self-dual length 48 automorphism' (6 hits, none binary length-48 order-15 exclusion), 'fixed subcode self-dual automorphism order 3' (0 hits) corroborate. The fixed-subcode self-duality lemma and GF(4)/GF(16) block-parity facts are standard representation-theoretic tools, but no source states the instantiated headline — nonexistence of binary self-dual [48,24] (hence extremal Type II [48,24,12]) with 15-(3;3) — nor does any general theorem plus arithmetic cited at Admission mechanically yield it without the new instantiation. Originality PASS.
